query.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT JSONExtractString(labels,'k8s.cluster.name') FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 WHERE metric_name='slimfaas_cpu_usage_percent' AND JSONExtractString(labels,'k8s.cluster.name')!='' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: CPU usage

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, '' AS series, max(v) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000), INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS time, s.fingerprint AS fp, JSONExtractString(t.labels,'k8s.cluster.name') AS cluster, anyLast(s.value) AS v FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 s INNER JOIN (SELECT fingerprint, any(labels) AS labels FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 WHERE metric_name='slimfaas_cpu_usage_percent' GROUP BY fingerprint) t ON s.fingerprint=t.fingerprint WHERE s.metric_name='slimfaas_cpu_usage_percent' AND $__timeFilter(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000)) GROUP BY time, fp, cluster) WHERE cluster IN (${cluster:singlequote}) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: Process CPU as a percentage of the processors available to the runtime.

panels.title: CPU rate limiting active

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, '' AS series, max(v) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000), INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS time, s.fingerprint AS fp, JSONExtractString(t.labels,'k8s.cluster.name') AS cluster, anyLast(s.value) AS v FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 s INNER JOIN (SELECT fingerprint, any(labels) AS labels FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 WHERE metric_name='slimfaas_cpu_rate_limiting_active' GROUP BY fingerprint) t ON s.fingerprint=t.fingerprint WHERE s.metric_name='slimfaas_cpu_rate_limiting_active' AND $__timeFilter(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000)) GROUP BY time, fp, cluster) WHERE cluster IN (${cluster:singlequote}) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Queue ready items per function

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, function, sum(v) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000), INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS time, s.fingerprint AS fp, JSONExtractString(t.labels,'function') AS function, JSONExtractString(t.labels,'k8s.cluster.name') AS cluster, anyLast(s.value) AS v FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 s INNER JOIN (SELECT fingerprint, any(labels) AS labels FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 WHERE metric_name='slimfaas_function_queue_ready_items' GROUP BY fingerprint) t ON s.fingerprint=t.fingerprint WHERE s.metric_name='slimfaas_function_queue_ready_items' AND $__timeFilter(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000)) GROUP BY time, fp, cluster, function) WHERE cluster IN (${cluster:singlequote}) GROUP BY time, function ORDER BY time

panels.description: Async messages waiting to be dispatched. This is the signal SlimFaas autoscaling reads.

panels.title: Queue in flight per function

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, function, sum(v) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000), INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS time, s.fingerprint AS fp, JSONExtractString(t.labels,'function') AS function, JSONExtractString(t.labels,'k8s.cluster.name') AS cluster, anyLast(s.value) AS v FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 s INNER JOIN (SELECT fingerprint, any(labels) AS labels FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 WHERE metric_name='slimfaas_function_queue_in_flight_items' GROUP BY fingerprint) t ON s.fingerprint=t.fingerprint WHERE s.metric_name='slimfaas_function_queue_in_flight_items' AND $__timeFilter(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000)) GROUP BY time, fp, cluster, function) WHERE cluster IN (${cluster:singlequote}) GROUP BY time, function ORDER BY time

panels.description: Messages currently being processed by workers.

panels.title: Requests received by status code

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, code AS code, sum(r) AS value FROM (SELECT time, fp, cluster, code, greatest(v - lagInFrame(v,1,v) OVER (PARTITION BY fp ORDER BY time), 0) AS r FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000), INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS time, s.fingerprint AS fp, JSONExtractString(t.labels,'code') AS code, JSONExtractString(t.labels,'k8s.cluster.name') AS cluster, max(s.value) AS v FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 s INNER JOIN (SELECT fingerprint, any(labels) AS labels FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 WHERE metric_name='http_requests_received_total' GROUP BY fingerprint) t ON s.fingerprint=t.fingerprint WHERE s.metric_name='http_requests_received_total' AND $__timeFilter(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000)) GROUP BY time, fp, cluster, code)) WHERE cluster IN (${cluster:singlequote}) GROUP BY time, code ORDER BY time

panels.description: Inbound requests on the SlimFaas pipeline, per scrape interval.

panels.title: Outbound calls to functions

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, 'total' AS series, sum(r) AS value FROM (SELECT time, fp, cluster, greatest(v - lagInFrame(v,1,v) OVER (PARTITION BY fp ORDER BY time), 0) AS r FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000), INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS time, s.fingerprint AS fp, JSONExtractString(t.labels,'k8s.cluster.name') AS cluster, max(s.value) AS v FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 s INNER JOIN (SELECT fingerprint, any(labels) AS labels FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 WHERE metric_name='httpclient_requests_sent_total' GROUP BY fingerprint) t ON s.fingerprint=t.fingerprint WHERE s.metric_name='httpclient_requests_sent_total' AND $__timeFilter(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000)) GROUP BY time, fp, cluster)) WHERE cluster IN (${cluster:singlequote}) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: HttpClient calls SlimFaas made, which includes proxying to functions and the Kubernetes API.
